title: Vehicles
summary: How you build cars and other vehicles: proportions from the wheel size, body surfaces, panel gaps, glass, lamps and wheels.

request.brief: Submit a vehicle you modelled (an original design): the body shell with its panel gaps, glass and wheels, in the state you'd hand over. A finished body shell alone is fine.
must_include: Panel gaps, glass and lamps if you modelled them
Your rig or wheel pivots if you set them up

questions.ask: How do you build vehicle bodies? (from blueprints, curves and lofts, box modelling, SubD)
